text.en:
In memory of Brigadier General James L. Dalton who was killed in the battle for the capture of
Balete Pass, Nueva Vizcaya, the name "Balete Pass" is changed to "Dalton Pass."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, September 12, 1945.
